purpose: Candidate job boards for the Vietnamese job-search MVP. Listed sources are not automatically enabled or verified integrations.

sources.name: TopCV
sources.notes: Direct search requests returned HTTP 403 on repeated checks. Use posting-text or saved-HTML import; live direct scraping is not verified.

sources.name: Indeed Vietnam
sources.notes: Direct search requests returned HTTP 403 on repeated checks. No verified search parser.

sources.name: VietnamWorks
sources.notes: HTTP 200 search page contains loading placeholders and search metadata; listing retrieval requires further investigation.

sources.name: JoyWork
sources.notes: HTTP 200 jobs page did not expose posting links in the retrieved HTML. Client-side rendering needs further investigation.

sources.name: JobsGO
sources.notes: robots.txt returned HTTP 403, leaving access policy unconfirmed. The connector stops before requesting search content.

sources.name: CareerViet
sources.notes: Earlier separate search/detail calls encountered intermittent robots responses. The collect command reuses a validated in-memory policy for at most five minutes, checking every path. Two five-record direct collections and the full Codex run each fetched all five complete descriptions. First page only; future availability is not guaranteed.

sources.name: Vieclam24h
sources.notes: HTTP 200 contains embedded job data, but the keyword=python probe returned unrelated roles. Correct filter semantics and detail extraction remain unverified.
